title: CIDR allowlist
skill: State what must be rejected, not only what must pass

good: In allowlist.py, rewrite load_allowlist(lines) and is_allowed(ip, allowlist) with the ipaddress module. load_allowlist: strip each line; skip empty lines and lines that start with "#"; parse every other line with ipaddress.IPv4Network (strict, so host bits set like "10.0.0.1/8" raise; a bare address is a /32); IPv6, bad prefixes and extra text raise ValueError right away; a prefix shorter than /8 (including 0.0.0.0/0) raises ValueError as too broad. is_allowed: never raises; return False when ip is not a str (an int or bytes too), or when ipaddress.IPv4Address(ip) fails (spaces, leading zeros, "/32", IPv6 such as "::ffff:10.0.0.1"); else True only if the address is in one of the networks. An empty allowlist allows nothing. Keep both names and arguments. Do not change app.py or allowlist.txt. Then run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
lazy: The IP allowlist check is insecure, fix it.
